description: Source code for the RollingLogWriter class in Apache Spark, responsible for writing log entries to rolling log blocks with size management.

classes.name: RollingLogWriter
classes.description: A class that manages writing log entries into rolling log blocks, splitting based on size limit, with methods for writing, rolling over, closing, and flushing logs.

methods.name: writeLog
methods.description: Writes a log entry, creating a new log block if necessary, and rolls over if size limit exceeded.

methods.name: rollOver
methods.description: Saves the current log block and resets the writer for a new block.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Saves the current log block and resets the writer and last log time.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the current log block writer (for testing purposes).

methods.name: saveCurrentBlock
methods.description: Saves the current log block with a generated block ID.
